newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Southcorp sells tank products business.
newsitem.headline: Southcorp sells tank products business.

text.p: Appliance, packaging and wine group Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was selling its Tank Products business, with annual sales of more than A$20 million, to the privately owned Steel Tank and Pipe (STP).
Southcorp managing director Graham Kraehe said in a statement the sale, for an undisclosed sum, was consistent with the company's strategy of divesting non-core businesses.

The Tank Products businesses manufactures and markets liquid and pressure tanks, gas tanks and cylinkers, pressure vessel heads and large cable drums for Australian and South East Asian markets, with manufacturing sites in Sunshine (Victoria),

Steel Tank and Pipe joint managing director Stephen Weeks, who said sale contracts had been exchanged last week and his Newcastle-based company would take over the business this Friday, would not divulge the value of the sale.
Southcorp shares were seven cents lower at A$4.43 at 1.55 p.m. (0355 GMT) on Monday.
